compare_caption: Comparison of {count} torrents, one column each
compare_copy_failed: Couldn't get the magnet: Lodestar isn't responding. Try again.
compare_manual_help: Your browser blocked copying here. Press {shortcut} to copy the selected link.
compare_no_attributes: These torrents have no parsed attributes to compare.
compare_diff_partial_note: Only files that none or all of the torrents share are listed. Files that some, but not all, share aren't.
compare_diff_truncated: List shortened: open the torrent to see every file.
compare_choose_text: Select 2 to 5 torrents in Search, then choose Compare.
compare_error_count: Compare needs 2 to 5 torrents. Remove or choose some, or go back to Search.
compare_error_duplicate: The same torrent is in this comparison more than once. Remove one of them.
compare_error_bad_hash: One of these torrents isn't valid. Remove it to continue.
compare_error_not_found: One of these torrents isn't available. It may have been removed or hidden. Remove each in turn to find which, or go back to Search.
compare_error_network: Couldn't reach Lodestar. Check that it's running, then try again.
compare_error_server: Lodestar couldn't load this comparison. Try again in a moment.
compare_stale_text: Showing the last comparison that loaded.
